{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for severe disease and exclude sentinel values
severe_df_clean = trial_df[(trial_df['severity'] == 'severe') & (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0)]

# Compute the mean biomarker_baseline for severe patients (excluding sentinel values)
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
